episodeTitle.en: Taking control of your career | Ethan Evans (Amazon)
episodeTitle.zh: 掌控你的职业生涯 | 伊桑·埃文斯（亚马逊）

guestBioOfficial.en: Ethan Evans is a writer, career coach, course instructor, and retired VP at Amazon. During his 15 years at Amazon, he helped invent Prime Video, Amazon Video, the Amazon Appstore, Prime Gaming (formerly Twitch Prime), and Twitch Commerce. Prior to Amazon, Ethan spent 12 years in technical leadership roles at several East Coast startups. He writes a newsletter, Level Up, which publishes candid career advice and has a growing community of ambitious professionals to connect with. Ethan also offers a range of Leadership Development Courses via live online classes and on-demand courses. In this episode, we discuss: • The Magic Loop framework: a five-step process to grow your career
guestBioOfficial.zh:
伊桑·埃文斯是一位作家、职业教练、课程讲师，也是亚马逊的退休副总裁。在亚马逊的15年间，他参与开发了Prime Video、亚马逊视频、亚马逊应用商店、Prime Gaming（前身为Twitch Prime）和Twitch Commerce等产品。在加入亚马逊之前，伊桑曾在东海岸多家初创公司担任技术领导职位12年。他撰写的时事通讯《Level Up》为有抱负的专业人士提供真诚的职业建议，并拥有不断壮大的社群。伊桑还通过在线直播课程和按需课程提供一系列领导力发展课程。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：
• 魔术循环框架：一个助力职业发展的五步流程

title.en: Taking control of your career | Ethan Evans (Amazon)
title.zh: 掌控你的职业生涯 | 伊桑·埃文斯（亚马逊）

summary.en: Ethan shares a simple but powerful reframe: you don't need many ideas to be seen as inventive—just one good idea every month or two, even if expressing it takes years (what he calls the long arc of Prime and Kindle). He tells a candid story of failing on a major project for Jeff Bezos and what it taught him, and walks through 'The Magic Loop,' a deceptively simple practice he guarantees will help you get promoted. The episode is full of concrete career advice for senior individual contributors and managers, including how to stand out in interviews and how Amazon's core leadership principles actually work.
summary.zh: Ethan 分享了一个简单却有力的重新框架：你不需要很多点子就能被视为极具创造力——每个月想出一个好点子就够，哪怕把它做出来要花好几年（他用 Prime 和 Kindle 的长期打磨来说明）。他坦诚讲述了在一个重要项目上让 Jeff Bezos 失望的经历与教训，并拆解了“魔力循环”（The Magic Loop）——一个看似简单、却保证能帮你升职的方法。这期节目充满面向高级个人贡献者和管理者的具体职业建议，包括如何在面试中脱颖而出，以及亚马逊核心领导力原则的真正运作方式。
